findings.claim: PR title 'Flatten specs cross-cutting topology' is false on filesystem
findings.evidence: ls /Users/jasonlee/oyatie/specs/ shows only 'cross-cutting/' subdirectory; 26 JSONs still live under /specs/cross-cutting/, none at /specs/ flat root. No 'rename from'/'rename to' lines in pr-18.diff.
findings.impact: Textual flattening only; no actual file move.

findings.evidence: pr-18.diff L502-503 rewrites "$schema":"/specs/cross-cutting/plan-schema.json" -> "/specs/plan-schema.json"; L84-88 rewrites pointers to /specs/{root-hub-pointers,masterplan,master-plan-sequencing,gitops-vcs-replacement,test-standard}.json. None of those flat paths exist (verified via ls).
findings.impact: Any resolver following $schema or root-hub-pointers entries will 404. Schema validation breaks for affected JSONs.

findings.evidence: jq on specs/cross-cutting/masterplan.json shows $id=https://docs.oyatie.dev/specs/masterplan.json (already flat URL form, unchanged). $id is absolute-URL-based and decoupled from on-disk path, so $id stayed coherent — but the *textual* $schema rewrites in the diff create a new mismatch class between $schema literals and actual file locations.
findings.impact: $id remains valid; $schema literals introduced by this PR are stale on day one.

findings.evidence: jq on .omc/handoffs/finish-mcc-handoff-2026-05-14.json and session-handoff-2026-05-14.json returns null for both $id and $schema. PR-18 modified these but did not add schema metadata.
findings.impact: Handoffs remain unschematized; pre-existing condition, not introduced by this PR.

realist_check: CRITICAL findings hold: ADR-0119 ('specs flat root topology') and 26 textual references promise a flat topology that the merged tree does not deliver. Mitigated by: $id absolute URLs decouple from disk paths, so jsonschema runtime resolution via $id is unaffected; only literal $schema/pointer dereferences break.
